name: C-stress COMBO medium (modified) (PMC11334502)
description: C-stress COMBO medium (modified) — medium reported in PMC11334502, extracted for GrowthDB and mapped to BiGG.

provenance.citation: Medium composition from PMC11334502 (see GrowthDB record).
provenance.notes: Composition mapped to BiGG (mapper + salt dissociation); presence-based bounds; paper_amount retained. Added via GrowthDB curation.
provenance.verification_evidence: C:N:P ratios in COMBO medium were manipulated to impose resource stress by decreasing the concentration of one element from Balanced medium conditions... C:N:P molar ratios used for the chemostats were 320:16:1 (Balanced), 40:16:1 (C-stress), 320:6:1 (N-stress), and 320:16:0.2 (P-stress).

coverage_source.definition: pct_covered_all = components / (components + unresolved ingredients) — the legacy metric, which counts pipeline-derived components as covered. pct_covered_source = source-stated components / (those + unresolved ingredients + ingredients replaced by derived components). Component classes come from tools/component_evidence_classes.tsv. A null value means the denominator was zero; it does not mean 100.
